Disconcerting Stare.descriptionOnly: no path: its –6 and –2 are the stared-at target's

Encouraging Spell.descriptionOnly: no path: its +1 is on the morale bonus the spell grants its targets

Hinder.descriptionOnly: no path: its –10 on initiative is the cursed creature's
